visual_method.mechanism: Camera orientation changes which rays sample an unchanged spherical panorama. The recorded 3D baseline separately shows actual camera-path parallax.
visual_method.construction: Perspective camera inside the original image sphere; no invented camera translation. Flat image panning was rejected because it distorts viewing geometry.
references: Plenoxels: follow one camera ray into spatial samples; oblique camera and sparse labels
Gauge paths: retain object identity while orientation changes; shared object colour and matched states
visual_method.colour: Original source colours preserved; warm cream type, gold editorial labels, mint secondary text, deep green letterbox; no data colour mapping
